name: manual_28f355
claim: On shared coordination files, append and merge; never rewrite the whole file. Read the current file immediately before writing, add your change as a new dated section or merged row, note what you superseded instead of deleting it, and re-read and re-apply if a write lands after a concurrent change.

decisions.notes: An appended progress section in the shared execution tracker was lost when a concurrent writer rewrote the whole file; the content was recovered from the append-only board log, and the protocol request was sent to all agents on both hosts.
